notes.title: Patch 7.1
notes.content:
Thanks for your Feedback. This Patch will fix most of the reported bugs from version 7 so far.

-Fixed a bug where players were not able to get back on the Airship.
-Masters Ice and Fire spells now display the correct damage values.
-Fixed a bug where crafting a "masters firebolt" results in a "strong firebolt".
-The stairs in Jivanas first camp are now more accessible.
-Fixed a bug where the player was forced to a slow walking speed when holding down the "Jump" button after a jump.
-The Icy-Blade weapon will now show the correct name in Ida´s inventory.
-Ice effects will now disappear correctly.
-Jivana Ghost will no longer randomly flee from the player.
-Bandits on Evergreen-Island will no longer respawn immediately.
-Players will now respawn at the correct savepoint after dying at the Kane-Bossfight.

notes.title: Update - Version 7.0
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25654698/b0be467702f4f4397f327d60bf7bea3650ed6ce1.png
Continue your journey to Jivana island and its life spending magical tree. Destroy the machines that are draining the life out of your homeworld and defeat the evil that tries to overshadow everything and everyone you love.

The Early Access of Windscape is nearly over. This will be the last big content update before the full release. I want to take this opportunity and thank everyone who bought and supported Windscape - you made this possible.

Please keep the Feedback coming - this will enable me to deliver the best release version of Windscape possible.


Log:

-New explorable island Jivana.
-New weapons and armor.
-Bugfixes and balance changes on nearly every part of the game.

notes.title: Update - Version 6.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25654698/a339e6867262775b372b4a3d72ad6fdc926e1e0b.png

This is a huge, mainly technical update. There is NO new story content to discover (sorry for that). Performance was all over the place in old builds and that needed a lot of work. In short, i had to replace some tools and rework most of the games assets. That whole optimization process led to a few changes in the artstyle (mainly colors and vegetation).
Please expect bugs of previous working features or areas in this version.

I do want to thank you for your continuous feedback reports. They helped quite a lot to make Windscape an overall better experience :).

The next days are scheduled to fix any bugs that will get reported on this version. After that i will resume working on the next big content update. Ruven, the awesome guy creating all of Windscapes music, already started working on the final tracks.

I hope you are still as excited as I am about Windscape.

Details:

-Replaced all Unity Terrain tools (Terrain Mesh, Grass rendering, Texturing).
-New vegetation assets (grass flowers etc.)
-New vegetation shaders. Trees, grass and other vegetation are now moving slightly with the wind.
-Changed the camera render setup to gain more fps.
-Added mist to all scenes.
-Baked Ambient Occlusion into the asset textures to replace realtime Ambient Occlusion calculations.

notes.title: Update 4.4
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25654698/25e14580b4007d6a947062b45d0149ad0adcf31b.pngThis update will feature a huge performance boost for the first area (Evergreen Island) and some changes to the overall look. Especially on machines with weak CPUs as well as integrated graphics solutions there should be a noticeable jump in performance and a much more stable FPS. This is because of a complete rework of how the game loads and unloads the games areas. If you want to know more about the details, read the text below.
I am still working on the next content update and there will be more info on that in the next days / weeks on my facebook and twitter page.
 
Details:
Areas are now divided into chunks and loaded just when they are needed. This requires a lot of work to the already finished areas like the Evergreen Island. The average FPS jumps from 55 to 105 frames per second on my test PC.
Windscape now runs on the Unity Engine version 5.6. This brings some changes to the lightning setup and a few other minor things. However upgrading required quite some work, hence the long time without any updates / patches.
I have integrated a lot of new Assets into the Evergreen Island area and updated old assets to match the look of the new ones.
Fixed bugs based on player feedback.
The graveyard area will be reworked next to match the performance of the games other areas.
I am aware of AI problems (mainly getting stuck) and hope to fix all this issues in the next updates (it was pushed back time and time again).

notes.title: Patch - Version 4.1
notes.content:
Fixed a few minor problems as well as a bug that closes gates instead of opening them.

If you are not able to finish the artefact quest from Gaasi then have a look into your inventory. Make sure you have looted the "Key of Wisdom" from the last Dungeon (Ruins). The Quest and Item are now tied together - if you dont have the "Key of Wisdom" in your inventory please head back into the dungeon and just grab it.

Thanks for all the Feedback reports.

notes.title: Patch - Version 3.1
notes.content:
A big THANK YOU to everyone who sent me feedback reports or posted on the steam forums. This patch will squish most known bugs in version 3.0.

-Fixed a bug in the english localization that closes the dialog immediately after a player tries to speak with the elder.

-Fixed a bug that caused a pretty long delay after closing any menu.

-Added collision detection to the Airship.

-Rearranged some rocks that were floating a few meters above the ground.

-The “end of this content update” message was fixed and shows up at the pyramid.

-Fixed a problem on low end graphics cards where the Terrain was invisible (please send me an ingame Feedback if you still have this bug).

-Fixed Guard Armin’s Dialogue.

-Desaturated the grass color on Evergreen Island slightly.

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.content:
Dear Windscape friends,

I'm very happy to announce the next content update which features a whole new island to discover. Embark on a dangerous adventure deep inside the ruins of Maaki Desert where maze-like rooms, creepy enemies and many hidden secrets await. On top of that you are now able to craft your own armor and a few new weapons.

The content update is now available - make sure your game is up-to-date before playing! If you'll find any bugs or have other feedback, please report them by pressing F8 ingame.

Have much fun and please stay tuned for future updates,
Dennis

notes.title: Update - Version 2.0
notes.content:
Dear Windscape friends,

I'm very happy to announce the first big content update for my game! Since this wouldn't have been possible without your great help I would like to thank you as well.

As the update features new spooky areas, sinister dungeons and eerie enemies, it fits perfectly to Halloween. In addition, you'll find three new bosses, some tricky platforming sections and puzzles - and you will learn your first magical attacks!

The content update is now available - make sure your game is up-to-date before playing! If you'll find any bugs or have other feedback, please report them by pressing F8 ingame.

Have much fun and please stay tuned for future updates,
Dennis

notes.title: T minus 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

tomorrow is the big day. 

After almost 2 years in the making, Windscape is launching into Early Access.

I do hope that all of you will enjoy what has been created. It's been quite a ride but I am confident that you will like the result.

So what comes next?

- I hope you don't encounter too many bugs, but if you do, please use the ingame reporting functions (F8 and F9) to send the problems to me so I can adress them directly.

- Share all feedback, good (good) or bad (bad) with me either by reviewing the game (thank you) or on the Steam forums. I really want your input moving forward.

- Brainstorm and bring your ideas to the table. I really want to know what you would like Ida to discover on her future journeys, and no idea is too small to be put out there. And who knows, maybe I will pick up a few great ones and then we can honestly say:

We created the game together.

See you tomorrow,
Dennis
